reasons.detail: The runner hardcodes a 108009834-byte archive with SHA-256 664823c5d9f167bda342745d7b34a3ccb98fd7108723ba83643d9d09bf693900 rather than the pending Arm B archive.
The sandbox read-only binds complete host /usr, /bin, /lib, and /lib64 trees, so it cannot prove an enumerated dependency closure.
Executed child images, dynamic objects, successful file opens, environment reads, and network attempts are not independently enumerated and checked.
